parser_to_extraction.compatibility: Additive parser fields are retained; document_id, source_extension and parts are required. Unsupported or malformed locator values are rejected with diagnostics.

extraction_to_linking.compatibility: Document Linking accepts schema_version 1.2.x and additive 1.x; major version 2 requires a new adapter.

provenance.document_id: Parser-generated stable ID, forwarded unchanged through extraction_id lineage and linking input_documents.
provenance.row_id: Structured Extraction row_id, retained on link endpoints and evidence paths.
provenance.pdf: page_no, bbox, coordinate_origin, and page_size are retained in provenance.
provenance.xlsx: sheet_name and cell_address are retained in provenance.
